The '''Merit Board''' was an organization of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the time of the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. Upon taking control of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] [[Courageous (Inexpugnable-class)|''Courageous'']], [[Saul Karath]] was waiting for promotion by the board.
